pages.text: The $(item)Ship's Compass$() points to the ship you crew, wherever she's sailed; hold it to see how far she is. You get one with your first deed, and you can craft more from a $(item)compass$() and a $(item)copper ingot$().

If she's too far away to be tracked, the needle points to where she was last seen. With no ship, it spins.$(br2)Sleep in her $(l)bunk$() and you'll respawn aboard her wherever she is, so you can always get back to her (see $(l)Life Aboard$()).
